g1|variants|cash sale.summary: The Cash Sale family handles counter-sales and immediate pickup scenarios where sales order creation triggers an instantaneous outbound delivery. Variants differ in whether the transaction is settled via order-related cash billing with receipt printout, delivery-related standard billing, digital/card payment settlement, or counter return refunding.

variants.name: Standard Cash Sale (BV)
variants.when_used: Customer orders, pays cash at counter, and receives goods immediately; sales order printout serves as invoice receipt.
variants.key_config: TVAK-AUTLF = 'X' (Immediate delivery); Output type RD03 assigned to order header; Billing type BV order-related.

variants.name: Rush Order (RO)
variants.when_used: Customer orders and takes goods immediately or requests immediate dispatch, but billing and invoicing occur later through normal AR cycles.
variants.key_config: TVAK-AUTLF = 'X' (Immediate delivery); Item category TAN billing relevance 'A'; Billing type F2 delivery-related.

variants.name: Walk-In Cash Sale with One-Time Customer (CPD)
variants.when_used: Unregistered counter customer pays cash and takes goods immediately; customer address is maintained directly on the order document.
variants.key_config: Account group CPD/CPDA assigned to one-time sold-to; TVAK-AUTLF = 'X'; Billing type BV with G/L cash clearing account.

variants.name: Counter Cash Sale with Payment Card / Digital Payments
variants.when_used: Counter customer takes goods immediately and settles via credit/debit card or contactless payment cleared via SAP digital payments add-on.
variants.key_config: Payment card plan activated in sales order; real-time authorization pre-requisite for immediate delivery creation; payment clearing at billing.

variants.name: Counter Cash Return (BV2)
variants.when_used: Customer returns goods to counter for immediate product restock and immediate cash refund or store credit payout.
variants.key_config: Order type BV2 configured with immediate return delivery; billing type BV2 generates credit memo with cash disbursement posting.

g1|core|cash sale|standard cash sale (bv.title: Standard Cash Sale (BV)
g1|core|cash sale|standard cash sale (bv.story: A customer walks up to an order desk, picks up products, pays right then, and leaves with both the goods and a printed receipt. In SAP S/4HANA, the sales clerk enters a Cash Sale order (document type BV), which immediately generates an outbound delivery in the background and prints an order-based receipt (output RD03) serving as the customer's invoice. Warehouse staff later post goods issue against the delivery, and finance runs order-related billing (billing type BV) to clear the cash balance without sending a second invoice to the customer.
g1|core|cash sale|standard cash sale (bv.why_business_needs_it: Trade counters and factory outlets require instantaneous counter pickup without making walk-in customers wait for asynchronous background delivery batches. It collapses sales order creation, picking notification, and customer invoicing documentation into a single customer-facing counter interaction while maintaining standard inventory and accounting integrity.

modules.hands_off_to: LE-SHP (Shipping) via automatic background delivery creation.

g1|core|cash sale|rush order (ro).story: A customer needs their goods right away at the counter or warehouse, but pays later through standard invoicing. In this scenario, saving the sales order triggers the instant automatic generation of an outbound delivery document in the background, allowing warehouse staff to pick, pack, and post goods issue immediately while accounts receivable invoices the delivery later via standard billing.
g1|core|cash sale|rush order (ro).why_business_needs_it: It streamlines counter sales and emergency orders by cutting out manual background delivery creation batches. Sales representatives satisfy urgent client demands in real time while maintaining regular credit limits, logistics tracking, and delivery-related invoicing controls.

prerequisites: Enterprise Structure: Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Division, Plant, and Shipping Point assigned (OVX5, OVX3, OVX6, OVXC)
Customer Master / Business Partner created in FI Customer (FLCU00) and Customer Sales Area (FLCU01) roles (BP)
Material Master extended to Sales Area and Plant with Item Category Group NORM (MM01)
Condition records maintained for pricing condition PR00 (VK11)

config_steps.step: Define Sales Document Type RO for Immediate Delivery
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Maintain Sales Order Types": Details
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: RO, Cat: C, Delivery Type: LF, Immed Delivery: X, Billing Type: F2
config_steps.check: Open transaction VA01, enter order type RO, and verify Delivery Type LF is populated in header shipping control view
config_steps.why: The system needs to know which delivery document to create automatically at the sales counter. Setting Immediate delivery triggers instant background delivery generation upon sales order save.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order saves without generating an outbound delivery, blocking counter fulfillment until manually processed in transaction VL01N.
actions: Enter /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter
Select sales document type RO and click Details (F2) or Copy As (F6)
Set SD Document Category to C (Order)
Enter LF in Delivery Type under Shipping section
Enter X in Immediate delivery field
Enter 10 in Shipping Conditions if defaulting counter pickup
Enter F2 in Dlv-rel.billing type under Billing section
Ensure Billing block is blank
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

fields.note: Standard Rush Order sales document type
Creates delivery automatically when order is saved
Default invoice type created against outbound delivery
Must remain empty to allow unblocked billing

config_steps.step: Assign Item Categories to Sales Document Type RO
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: RO + NORM -> Default item category TAN
config_steps.check: Execute transaction VA01 with order type RO, add standard material MAT-RO-01, and confirm item category defaults to TAN
config_steps.why: The system must identify the operational profile of the line item added to the rush order. Assigning TAN ensures the line item is flagged for warehouse staging, goods movement, and invoice generation.
config_steps.if_missing: The system issues error V1 320 'Item category cannot be determined', preventing the user from entering items on the sales order.
actions: Enter /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter
Click Position and enter Sales Doc. Type RO with Item Category Group NORM
If entry does not exist, click New Entries (F5)
Enter RO in Sales Doc. Type
Enter NORM in Item Category Group
Enter TAN in Default Item Category
Press Enter to validate the line assignment
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

Leave blank to enforce TAN default

config_steps.step: Define Item Category TAN Controls for Delivery-Related Billing
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item Category: TAN, Billing Relevance: A, Item Rel. Delivery: X, Sched. Lines Allowed: X
config_steps.check: View table entry in SE16N for TVAP where PSTYV = 'TAN' and check FKREL = 'A'
config_steps.why: Rush orders dispatch goods prior to invoicing, requiring delivery-related billing controls. Setting Billing Relevance to A instructs billing run VF01 to read quantities from delivery LF rather than order RO.
config_steps.if_missing: Billing document creation fails or invoices unconfirmed order quantities prematurely without waiting for actual goods issue quantities.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select item category TAN and click Details (F2)
Verify Item Relevant for Delivery is checked (flag X)
Set Billing Relevance to A (Delivery-related billing document)
Verify Schedule Lines Allowed is checked (flag X)
Verify Pricing is set to X (Standard pricing active)
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

Enables schedule line generation and stock confirmation

config_steps.step: Configure Schedule Line Category CP for Inventory Posting
config_steps.where: VOV6 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Define Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.values: Sched Line: CP, Mvt: 601, Delivery Rel: X, ATP: X, Req: X
config_steps.check: Open transaction VOV6, navigate to CP, and confirm Movement Type is set to 601
config_steps.why: The schedule line determines how inventory is depleted when items leave the dock. Linking movement type 601 enables transaction VL02N to execute Post Goods Issue (PGI) and reduce unrestricted inventory.
config_steps.if_missing: Post goods issue in transaction VL02N will fail with error indicating no movement type is assigned to schedule line CP.
actions: Enter /nVOV6 in the command field and press Enter
Select schedule line category CP and click Details (F2)
Enter 601 in Movement Type
Check Item Relevant for Delivery (flag X)
Check Requirements/Assembly (flag X)
Check Availability Check (flag X)
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Assign Schedule Line Categories to Item Category TAN
config_steps.where: VOV5 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Assign Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Schedule Line Category Assignment": Overview

config_steps.check: Create order in transaction VA01 with item category TAN, view Schedule Lines tab, and confirm schedule line CP is assigned
config_steps.why: The system must map the combination of order item category and material planning code to an executable stock line. Defaulting CP guarantees stock availability confirmation and delivery feasibility.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order line item cannot schedule a delivery date, triggering error V1 275 'Schedule lines are not allowed for item'.
actions: Enter /nVOV5 in the command field and press Enter
Click Position and enter Item Category TAN with MRP type ND
If entry does not exist, click New Entries (F5)
Enter TAN in Item Category
Enter ND in MRP Type (No Planning) or leave blank for default

config_steps.step: Configure Shipping Point Determination for Immediate Delivery
config_steps.where: OVL2 -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Basic Shipping Functions > Shipping Point and Goods Receiving Point Determination > Assign Shipping Points
config_steps.values: SC: 10 + LoadGrp: 0001 + Plant: 1010 -> ShpPoint: 1010
config_steps.check: Execute transaction VA01, enter order type RO, customer with shipping condition 10, plant 1010, and verify shipping point 1010 auto-populates
config_steps.why: Immediate delivery generation cannot occur unless a unique shipping point is determined automatically. The engine matches customer shipping terms, material loading profile, and plant to locate the loading dock.
config_steps.if_missing: Delivery generation fails during sales order save with shipping point determination error VL 014.
actions: Enter /nOVL2 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries (F5)
Enter 10 in Shipping Conditions
Enter 0001 in Loading Group
Enter 1010 in Plant
Enter 1010 in Proposed Shipping Point
Press Enter to validate the line entry
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Maintain Copy Control from Sales Document RO to Delivery Type LF
config_steps.where: VTLA -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Copying Control > Specify Copy Control for Deliveries
config_steps.values: Source: RO -> Target: LF, Item: TAN, Routine: 101, Req: 001
config_steps.check: Save a rush order in transaction VA01 and check transaction V_SA to confirm the outbound delivery LF was spawned by copy control
config_steps.why: The system requires formal copy rules to transfer customer, material, and schedule line quantities from the sales order into the outbound delivery. Copy control VTLA provides the field transfer logic for background delivery generation.
config_steps.if_missing: Background delivery generation aborts upon saving the order with message VL 065 'Copy control table entry is missing'.
actions: Enter /nVTLA in the command field and press Enter
Switch to Change Mode (Ctrl+F1)
Select target delivery type LF and source sales doc type RO, then double-click Item folder
Select item category TAN and click Details (F2)
Set Order Requirement to 001 (Header requirement)
Set Item Requirement to 101 (Item requirement)
Set Data Transfer Routine to 101
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Maintain Copy Control from Outbound Delivery LF to Billing Document F2
config_steps.where: VTFL -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Documents > Maintain Copying Control For Billing Documents
config_steps.values: Target: F2 <- Source: LF, Item: TAN, CopyReq: 009, BillQty: C, PricingType: G
config_steps.check: Run transaction VF01 referencing an outbound delivery LF and verify that line items, quantities, and pricing copy correctly into billing type F2
config_steps.why: Accounts receivable must invoice customers based on what physically left the shipping dock rather than initial counter orders. Setting Copying Requirement 009 and Billing Quantity C guarantees billing reflects post-goods-issue delivery records.
config_steps.if_missing: Billing creation in transaction VF01 fails with error VF 044 'Copying requirements 009 not met', or creates incorrect invoice quantities.
actions: Enter /nVTFL in the command field and press Enter
Switch to Change Mode (Ctrl+F1)
Select Target F2 and Source LF, then double-click Item folder
Select item category TAN and click Details (F2)
Set Copying Requirement to 009 (Delivery-related)
Set Billing Quantity to C (Cumulative delivery quantity minus invoiced quantity)
Set Pricing Type to G (Copy pricing elements unchanged and redetermine taxes)
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to customizing transport request

Restricts billable quantity strictly to picked and issued units
Preserves base sales prices while redetermining dynamic taxes

config_steps.screen_title: Maintain Business Partner: Customer Sales Area Details
config_steps.values: BP Role: FLCU01, Shipping Cond: 10, Delivering Plant: 1010
config_steps.check: Create order in transaction VA01 using customer BP-CUST-01 and verify Shipping Conditions 10 auto-populates on header shipping screen
config_steps.why: The business partner provides default shipping terms to drive automated delivery point determination. Setting Shipping Conditions 10 on the customer record aligns the order with the configured shipping point rule.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order pulls standard freight terms, failing shipping point determination and halting immediate delivery generation.

Switch to BP Role FLCU01 (Customer)
Click Sales and Distribution button at top toolbar
Select Sales Area (Sales Org 1010, Distr. Channel 10, Division 00)

Set Delivering Plant to 1010
Navigate to Billing tab and verify Invoicing Dates are blank

errors.title: Immediate Delivery Creation Fails on Rush Order Save
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- Saving Rush Order (RO)
errors.message_text: Order &1 has been saved (delivery &2 not created)
errors.plain_meaning: The sales order was saved, but the system could not create the shipping paperwork automatically. Rush orders are configured to generate an outbound delivery LF instantly upon save, but an underlying shipping or scheduling block halted delivery creation.
errors.cause: Sales document type RO has immediate delivery activated (TVAK-AUTLF = 'X'), but the line item lacks confirmed schedule line quantity, shipping point determination fails, or an order delivery block is active.
errors.config_step: Define Sales Document Types (VOV8) and Shipping Point Determination (OVL2)
errors.verify: Execute VA01 for order type RO, enter required material and partner, then save. Confirm status bar reads 'Order &1 has been saved (delivery &2 created)'.
errors.prevent: Mandate shipping condition defaults in Business Partner customer master records and maintain complete loading group mappings in OVL2 during material master governance workflows.
errors.ref_title: SAP Note 2534575 - Delivery not created automatically during sales order creation

fix_steps.step: Inspect delivery creation log in sales order
fix_steps.where: VA02 -> Edit -> Log of incomplete items, or check delivery creation log in menu Environment
fix_steps.values: Determine specific blocking factor (missing shipping point, zero confirmed stock, or credit hold)

fix_steps.step: Verify shipping point determination configuration
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Basic Shipping Functions -> Shipping Point and Goods Receiving Point Determination -> Assign Shipping Points (T-code OVL2)
fix_steps.values: Shipping Condition (from RO or BP) + Loading Group (MARC-LADGR) + Delivering Plant (VBAP-WERKS) -> Proposed Shipping Point

fix_steps.step: Verify item schedule line confirmation and ATP settings
fix_steps.values: Assign Item Category TAN to Schedule Line Category CP with 'Req./Assembly' and 'Availability check' enabled

errors.title: Shipping Point Determination Failure during Item Entry
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- Entering line item in Rush Order
errors.message_text: Shipping point could not be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not know which dock or warehouse door will dispatch the goods. An outbound delivery cannot be scheduled or created without an assigned shipping point.
errors.cause: The combination of Shipping Condition (VBKD-VSBED), Loading Group (MARC-LADGR), and Delivering Plant (VBAP-WERKS) has no matching rule in table TVSTZ.
errors.config_step: Assign Shipping Points (OVL2)
errors.verify: Re-enter the material line item in VA01 under document type RO. Verify field VBAP-VSTEL populates automatically with the designated shipping point.
errors.prevent: Enforce mandatory Loading Group entry on MARC-LADGR during material creation and populate Shipping Conditions in all OTC customer master sales area views.
errors.ref_title: SAP Community: Shipping point determination in sales order

fix_steps.step: Identify shipping parameters in sales order line
fix_steps.where: VA01 -> Line Item Details -> Shipping tab
fix_steps.values: Note Delivering Plant, check Loading Group from material master sales: general/plant tab, and Shipping Condition in header shipping tab

fix_steps.step: Maintain shipping point determination table
fix_steps.values: Insert row: Shipping Condition + Loading Group + Plant = Default Shipping Point

errors.title: Immediate Delivery Blocked by S/4HANA Credit Check
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- Saving Rush Order (RO)
errors.message_text: Credit limit exceeded by &1 &2
errors.plain_meaning: The customer has reached their maximum credit balance, so the system stops the delivery paperwork from generating. Because a rush order requires fast counter dispatch, the customer cannot take the goods until the credit hold is resolved.
errors.cause: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management (FSCM UKM) or automatic SD credit check triggers due to exposure exceeding the customer credit limit, placing a delivery block (VBAK-LIFSK) on the order.
errors.config_step: Define Automatic Credit Control (OVA8) and Document Type Credit Check (VOV8)
errors.verify: Save the released order in VA02 or execute VL01N. Confirm Outbound Delivery LF generates without delivery block LF-LIFSK.
errors.prevent: Establish dedicated counter risk classes with adjusted limit checks or pre-authorized payment mechanisms for accounts authorized to execute rush pickups.
errors.ref_title: SAP Knowledge Base Article 2788718 - Delivery blocked due to credit limit in S/4HANA

fix_steps.step: Identify active credit hold
fix_steps.where: T-code VKM3 or Fiori App Manage Documented Credit Decisions (UKM_MY_DCDS)
fix_steps.values: Inspect credit exposure against credit limit for Credit Account

fix_steps.step: Evaluate Rush Order credit policy configuration
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Credit Management/Risk Management -> Credit Management -> Define Automatic Credit Control (T-code OVA8)
fix_steps.values: Review Credit Control Area + Risk Category + Document Credit Group (01 for Order) to determine whether immediate delivery block is mandatory or requires counter override

fix_steps.step: Release the blocked document
fix_steps.where: T-code VKM3 or Fiori App UKM_MY_DCDS
fix_steps.values: Select Documented Credit Decision (DCD), approve and release credit block

errors.title: Goods Issue Blocked by Inventory Deficit
errors.where_seen: VL02N -- Post Goods Issue for Outbound Delivery LF
errors.message_text: Deficit of &1 &2 &3 &4
errors.plain_meaning: There is not enough inventory recorded in the system storage location to hand the items to the customer. Goods issue cannot complete until stock is posted.
errors.cause: Storage location unrestricted inventory in table MARD is lower than the delivery pick quantity when posting Goods Issue via Movement Type 601.
errors.config_step: Define Schedule Line Categories (VOV6) & Maintain Inventory Postings (MIGO)
errors.verify: In VL02N, verify Status Overview shows Total Goods Movement Status as 'C' (Completely processed) and material document is created.
errors.prevent: Configure ATP checking rule in OVZ9 to include only unrestricted stock without non-replenishment lead time for fast counter item fulfillment.
errors.ref_title: SAP Knowledge Base Article 2210569 - Deficit of SL Unrestricted-use stock

fix_steps.step: Analyze current inventory and requirement segments
fix_steps.values: Check unrestricted-use stock balance against open deliveries for the plant and storage location

fix_steps.step: Post missing stock or storage location transfer
fix_steps.values: Execute goods receipt (Movement Type 101/561) or transfer posting from reserve storage location (Movement Type 311)

fix_steps.step: Re-execute Goods Issue in delivery
fix_steps.values: Enter Delivery LF, verify Picking quantity equals Delivery quantity, click 'Post Goods Issue'

errors.title: Billing Blocked Prior to Post Goods Issue Execution
errors.where_seen: VF01 -- Create Billing Document (F2)
errors.message_text: Delivery &1 has not yet been processed by the warehouse
errors.plain_meaning: You cannot print the invoice because the warehouse has not finished recording that the items left the building. Unlike a standard cash sale BV, a rush order F2 invoice requires post goods issue before billing.
errors.cause: Item category TAN in the rush order has Billing Relevance 'A' (Delivery-related billing document - status according to goods issue). Outbound delivery LF has Goods Movement Status (VBUK-WBSTK / VBUP-WBSTA) not equal to 'C'.
errors.config_step: Define Item Categories (VOV7 - field FKREL) and Maintain Copy Control (VTFL)
errors.verify: Execute VF01 with Outbound Delivery LF number. System displays invoice overview screen without message VF 044.
errors.prevent: Automate Post Goods Issue simultaneously with delivery creation for rush order profiles where warehouse picking is finalized at the sales counter.
errors.ref_title: SAP Note 2530752 - Message VF044 during billing creation for outbound delivery

fix_steps.step: Verify delivery overall goods movement status
fix_steps.values: Field Overall Goods Movement Status (WBSTK) displays 'A' (Not yet processed) or 'B' (Partially processed)

fix_steps.step: Complete picking and post goods issue
fix_steps.values: Confirm pick quantity equals delivered quantity, then click 'Post Goods Issue'

fix_steps.step: Verify item category billing relevance configuration
fix_steps.values: Item Category TAN: Billing Relevance (FKREL) = 'A' (Standard for Rush Order F2)

errors.title: Missing Copy Control between Delivery LF and Billing F2 for Item TAN
errors.where_seen: VF01 / VF04 -- Billing Document Processing
errors.message_text: Copying of &1 &2 to &3 &4 is not supported
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not have the rulebook to turn this delivery note into an invoice. The copy control table connecting delivery LF to billing type F2 for line item TAN is missing.
errors.cause: Table TVCPF lacks an entry for Target Billing Type F2, Source Delivery Type LF, and Item Category TAN, preventing document flow conversion.
errors.config_step: Maintain Copying Control for Delivery to Billing Documents (VTFL)
errors.verify: Execute VF01 entering Outbound Delivery LF. System populates invoice line item TAN and calculates net value.
errors.prevent: Include table TVCPF item category checks in transport release gates whenever new item categories or delivery types are deployed.
errors.ref_title: SAP Knowledge Base Article 2552865 - Copying control between delivery and billing

fix_steps.step: Access delivery-to-billing copy control maintenance
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Billing Documents -> Maintain Copying Control For Billing Documents -> Copying control: Delivery document to billing document (T-code VTFL)
fix_steps.values: Target: F2, Source: LF

errors.title: Customer Receipt Output RD00 Generation Failure
errors.where_seen: VF01 / VF02 -- Output determination for Invoice F2
errors.message_text: Output &1 could not be issued
errors.plain_meaning: The paper receipt or invoice cannot print because the system cannot find a valid printer or output instruction. The counter clerk cannot hand the invoice to the customer.
errors.cause: Condition records for output type RD00 are missing in table NAST/NACH or S/4HANA BRF+ Output Parameter Determination (OPD), or user spool device is not configured for counter printing.
errors.config_step: Maintain Output Condition Records (VV31 / OPD) and Spool Parameters
errors.verify: Open billing document in VF02 -> Goto -> Header -> Output. Confirm output RD00 status light is green and document prints at the counter spool.
errors.prevent: Set default fallback print queues in OPD / VV31 catch-all records to prevent hard output errors during peak counter hours.
errors.ref_title: SAP Note 2941522 - Output determination in Billing Documents (S/4HANA)

fix_steps.step: Maintain condition records in classical SD output determination
fix_steps.values: Output Type: RD00, Key Combination: Billing Type F2 + Sales Org; Medium: 1 (Print); Timing: 4 (Send immediately)

fix_steps.step: Maintain rules in S/4HANA Output Parameter Determination
fix_steps.values: Select Application 'Billing Document'; ensure rules exist for Output Type (BILLING_DOCUMENT / RD00), Channel (PRINT), and Printer Settings (assign valid physical printer)

fix_steps.step: Verify user spool default
fix_steps.values: Ensure Output Device field contains active counter printer (e.g., LOCL or designated spool printer)

g1|core|cash sale|walk-in cash sale with.title: Walk-In Cash Sale with One-Time Customer (CPD)
g1|core|cash sale|walk-in cash sale with.story: A walk-in customer buys goods at a counter, pays cash on the spot, and walks away with both the products and a printed receipt in one single visit. In SAP, entering a Cash Sale order immediately creates an outbound delivery behind the scenes and prints an order receipt that serves as the customer invoice. The back-office executes order-related billing against the sales order to post revenues against a one-time customer account without creating open accounts receivable balances.
g1|core|cash sale|walk-in cash sale with.why_business_needs_it: Counter sales operations require immediate physical goods handover and instant receipt printing without multi-step shipping and invoicing bottlenecks. It eliminates the overhead of creating permanent master records for occasional walk-in buyers while ensuring inventory decrement, tax reporting, and cash reconciliations remain fully compliant.

modules.role: Captures the walk-in sales order, captures one-time address data, and triggers immediate delivery and receipt printing.
modules.hands_off_to: SD-SHP for immediate delivery generation and SD-BIL for order-related invoice processing.

modules.role: Processes the automatically generated outbound delivery, stock picking, and goods issue posting.
modules.hands_off_to: MM-IM for inventory deduction and FI for inventory asset accounting.

modules.role: Generates the internal order-related billing document to close the sales document flow.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR and FI-GL for revenue recording and cash clearing reconciliations.

modules.role: Records financial entries to the one-time customer reconciliation account and offsets against petty cash or cash clearing accounts.

Delivering Plant and Shipping Point configured and assigned (OVX6, OVXC).

Material Master created with Sales Org and Plant views, active MRP, and standard cost/moving average valuation (MM01).
Pricing condition records maintained for sales organization and distribution channel (VK11 - PR00).
Petty cash G/L account and reconciliation account configured for one-time customer postings (FS00).

g1|core|cash sale|counter cash sale with.title: Counter Cash Sale with Payment Card / Digital Payments
g1|core|cash sale|counter cash sale with.story: Imagine buying a toy at a store counter, paying immediately with a card, and walking out with the item and your receipt right away. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, a Cash Sale with payment card processing creates a sales order, an immediate outbound delivery, a billing document, and an accounting posting in one synchronized sequence. If any master data or payment authorization step is missing, the customer cannot complete the counter transaction and the register stalls. This scenario covers the complete OTC integration flow for document type BV with item category BVN, delivery type BV, billing type BV, and immediate payment card authorization.
g1|core|cash sale|counter cash sale with.why_business_needs_it: Retail and counter-sales environments require immediate order fulfillment, instant revenue recognition, and immediate payment card clearing at the point of sale. Without this specific configuration, orders would route through standard multi-day credit and delivery cycles instead of clearing immediately at the counter.

modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for immediate cash posting and digital payment settlement, and LE (Logistics Execution) for outbound delivery.

g1|core|cash sale|counter cash return (b.title: Counter Cash Return (BV2)
g1|core|cash sale|counter cash return (b.story: A customer brings a previously purchased item back to the counter for an immediate refund, and the system instantly issues a cash payout slip while reversing the stock and accounting entry. g1|core|cash sale|counter cash return (b.why_business_needs_it: Retail and counter sales operations require immediate return processing to handle customer refunds and inventory restocking in a single visit. Using sales document type BV2 ensures the refund is logged, financial credit is issued, and inventory adjustments occur synchronously.

g1|panel|cash sale.otc_impact: Cash sale (BV) bridges retail speed with enterprise accounting by executing order entry, delivery creation, billing document generation, and immediate cash collection within a single compressed transaction cycle. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, it bypasses traditional credit management and standard receivable open items, immediately posting revenue and tax directly to a cash clearing account via a billing-triggered accounting document. This eliminates Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) for these transactions, reduces unbilled revenue exposure, and accelerates counter turnaround time while maintaining strict statutory audit compliance.

panel_qa.question: Why use a Cash Sale order type instead of creating a standard sales order with immediate payment terms and an advance billing request?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Cash sale (BV) automates the entire fulfillment chain by triggering an immediate delivery and a pro-forma or actual billing document upon order save, bypassing standard credit holds. SAP is configured this way using sales document type BV assigned to delivery type BV and billing type IV, with immediate delivery creation flagged in Customizing. The leadership value is zero DSO, immediate cash recognition in finance, and reduced manual touchpoints at the counter. Next, we ensure seamless hand-offs to digital payment gateways for instant settlement. The weak answer to avoid is saying we use it because users prefer fewer screens, which ignores the underlying logistics and accounting automation.
panel_qa.trap: We use it because users prefer fewer screens, which ignores the underlying logistics and accounting automation.

panel_qa.question: How do we prevent inventory discrepancies when cash sales take physical stock directly from the counter without formal warehouse management tasks?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Counter cash sales rely on immediate goods issue posting at the moment the sales order is saved, instantly reducing unrestricted stock in plant and storage location. SAP is configured via schedule line category CP, which sets movement type 601 for immediate goods issue without requiring a warehouse task in Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) for fast-moving retail items. The leadership value is real-time inventory visibility, preventing out-of-stock conditions for high-demand walk-in items. Next, we audit storage location assignments per sales area to ensure proper inventory valuation. The weak answer to avoid is stating we let warehouse supervisors fix stock discrepancies at the end of the shift.
panel_qa.trap: We let warehouse supervisors fix stock discrepancies at the end of the shift.

panel_qa.question: What happens to our financial reporting and customer subledger if a cash sale payment fails or requires a customer refund?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Cash sales post revenue directly to a cash clearing account instead of an accounts receivable customer reconciliation account, unless a one-time customer (CPD) is used with immediate cash clearing. SAP is configured using billing type IV (Invoice) which posts directly to General Ledger accounts determined by account determination procedure KOFI00 with account assignment group settings. The leadership value is mitigated bad debt risk and clean statutory tax reporting without cluttering the aging report. Next, we enforce counter return document type BV2 for authorized refunds linked to the original billing document. The weak answer to avoid is assuming cash sales never have exceptions or returns.
panel_qa.trap: Assuming cash sales never have exceptions or returns.

panel_qa.question: How does SAP S/4HANA handle digital payment card integration during counter cash sales to ensure PCI compliance and secure auth?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Counter cash sales integrate with SAP Digital Payments Add-on or third-party payment service providers to authorize credit and debit cards synchronously during order entry. SAP is configured by assigning payment cards in sales order header data, activating authorization control in Customizing under Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Payment Cards. The leadership value is eliminated merchant fraud risk, secure tokenization, and automated cash reconciliation. Next, we monitor settlement batch jobs in FI-CA or FI-AR to verify cash capture. The weak answer to avoid is claiming payment card authorization happens asynchronously after the customer leaves the counter.
panel_qa.trap: Payment card authorization happens asynchronously after the customer leaves the counter.

panel_qa.question: What specific OTC configuration prevents a cash sale order from generating an open accounts receivable item in customer master records?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Sales document type BV uses billing type IV, which triggers cash sale accounting where the billing document posts directly to a cash/bank clearing account instead of creating an open item in customer accounts. SAP is configured in transaction VOFA for billing type IV with account determination where the debit goes to the house bank clearing account and credit to revenue/tax. The leadership value is accurate cash flow forecasting and keeping DSO metrics clean of retail transactions. Next, we verify output determination for immediate printout of the receipt/invoice at the counter. The weak answer to avoid is manually clearing open items in FBL5N after the fact.
panel_qa.trap: Manually clearing open items in FBL5N after the fact.

panel_qa.question: How do we manage walk-in customers using a one-time customer (CPD) account without violating tax compliance or creating duplicate master records?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Walk-in cash sales use a generic one-time customer master record where specific name, address, and tax jurisdiction data are captured directly in the sales order partner functions (AG, WE) at entry. SAP is configured by enabling address screen control in customer account groups and setting mandatory tax destination checks in SD pricing. The leadership value is audit-ready transactional tax calculation based on physical counter location while avoiding master data bloat. Next, we periodically purge temporary one-time customer address logs. The weak answer to avoid is using a single static customer record for all cash sales without capturing local tax data.
panel_qa.trap: Using a single static customer record for all cash sales without capturing local tax data.
